metadata.title: Privacy policy | My Fiscal Code
metadata.description: Information about the processing of personal data.

controller.title: Data controller
controller.missingContact: Before publishing, configure a contact email address with the <variable>PRIVACY_CONTACT_EMAIL</variable> environment variable.

dataProcessed.title: Data processed
dataProcessed.body: To calculate the Italian fiscal code, the application processes first name, last name, date of birth, sex, and place of birth. While you browse, the infrastructure provider may also process technical data, such as your IP address, user agent, and request information.

purpose.title: Purposes and legal basis
purpose.body: The data entered in the form is used exclusively to calculate and return the requested Italian fiscal code. Processing is necessary to provide the service requested by the user. Any technical data is processed to operate and protect the website.

storage.title: Processing and retention
storage.body: The calculation takes place on the server. The application does not save the data entered in the form to the database and does not intentionally record it in logs. The data remains in memory only for the time needed to process the request. Technical providers may retain logs according to their own configurations and retention policies.

recipients.title: Recipients and service providers
recipients.body: The website is hosted on Vercel. The cadastral code lookup is performed in the MongoDB database configured by the controller. These providers may process the technical data required to deliver their respective services. Any transfers outside the European Economic Area take place under the safeguards provided by the providers and applicable law.

cookies.title: Cookies and tracking technologies
cookies.body: The application code does not use profiling cookies, behavioral advertising, or analytics tools. If non-essential tools are introduced in the future, this policy and the consent collection process will be updated before their activation.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: Where provided by law, users may request access to, rectification or erasure of their data, restriction of processing, or object to processing. They may also lodge a complaint with the <authority>Italian Data Protection Authority</authority>.

provision.title: Providing your data
provision.body: Providing the data requested by the form is optional, but the Italian fiscal code cannot be calculated without it.

metadata.title: About | My Fiscal Code
metadata.description: Information about the My Fiscal Code project and how it works.

AboutPage.title: About
AboutPage.introduction: I built this website to practice with Next.js and deploying it on Vercel.
AboutPage.motivation: The idea came to me when I needed to calculate an Italian fiscal code and thought: “Why should I send sensitive data to some unknown server? And once the data reaches its destination, how is it processed?”
AboutPage.response: So I told myself: “if you want something done right, do it yourself,” and I built this project.
AboutPage.howItWorks: It works in three simple steps:

steps.form: the user fills out the form
steps.calculation: a Server Action calculates the Italian fiscal code
steps.result: if all the data is valid, it returns the calculated fiscal code; otherwise, it returns an error.

AboutPage.processing: The data is sent to the server and processed only to calculate the Italian fiscal code. The application does not save it to the database or intentionally record it in logs.
AboutPage.persistentData: The only persistent data in this system is the list of Italian municipalities and the list of foreign countries. These lists are used to obtain the four-character alphanumeric cadastral code associated with the place of birth.
AboutPage.source: The source code is available in the <repository>MyFiscalCode repository on GitHub</repository>.
AboutPage.repositoryAriaLabel: Open the MyFiscalCode repository on GitHub
